patterns.name: supported_reading_at_native_speed
patterns.tested_result: Improved gaze and expression timing relative to prior half-speed Veo edit. Softer facial detail. Selected for restrained opening only.
patterns.guidance: Use the reviewed still to establish supported limbs and gaze target. Describe small coherent reading behavior; do not prohibit all expressions and then slow the take to fit. Render UI independently.
limitations: Only one reference and one paid candidate
No speech, typing or cross-shot identity test
Does not solve all skin/detail realism concerns

patterns.name: purposeful_device_contact_still_first
patterns.tested_result: Partial improvement: source establishes separate hands and task contact; motion adds brief lift/reposition instead of continuous glide. Gaze stays laptop-directed but expression remains very restrained. Not integrated.
patterns.guidance: Establish useful hand roles in the still; animate a single small action and pause. Judge contact throughout the action, not just initial/final frames. Do not label a good starting pose a solved animation.
limitations: One candidate, source pose and matching action prompt both changed; no supported input seed control. Not a causal still-only experiment or model ranking.
No real reference-clip likeness or motion was directly copied; behavioral findings only.
No speech, cross-shot identity, typing sequence, UI correctness or full-film integration tested.

patterns.name: supplied_dark_slack_reference_deterministic_ui
patterns.tested_result: Sharp dark Slack shell and matching thread, consistent typography and local preview thumbnail. Encoded samples and composition checks passed.
patterns.guidance: Reconstruct screenshot surfaces and layout in HTML, retain fictional narrative labels, capture thumbnails from the actual page composition, and inspect caption transparency in the encoded film.
limitations: Subjective style improvement; no numeric or causal realism score
